data.what_it_does: Provides a template application structure for plugin examples. It allows developers to quickly set up example apps for their plugins using a predefined UI layout, github URL, pub.dev URL, and custom pages.
use_when: You are building a Flutter plugin and need a consistent example app structure.
You want to showcase plugin features using pre-built layout pages.
avoid_when: You are building a standard end-user mobile or web application rather than a plugin.
You need a custom UI that does not fit the template's structure.
strengths: Speeds up the creation of plugin example apps.
Ensures consistency across different plugin examples.
weaknesses: Limited to specific template layouts and use cases.
Not suitable for building general production applications.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to the example yaml and initialize using the BaseflowPluginExample widget.
